title: Dory looks for her mum and dad.
lines: A fish lives in the big blue sea.
She is blue with a yellow tail.
Dory is very cheerful and kind.
But Dory forgets everything very quickly.
What she has just heard, she has forgotten a minute later.
Nemo is orange with white stripes.
One day Dory sees a group of stingrays.
Something from a very long time ago.
I have a mum and dad too!
I lost them when I was very little.
The Jewel of Morro Bay, California.
They swim across the whole ocean.
They ride on the backs of big turtles.
They arrive at a big building.
People help sick sea animals there.
Dory gets picked up by mistake.
She ends up in a tank.
In return he wants Dory's tag.
Then he can go to a quiet aquarium.
Dory also meets Destiny, a whale shark who can't see very well.
And Bailey, a white whale who thinks his head is broken.
She follows little shells on the ground.
When she was little, her mum and dad laid out shells.
So that she would always find the way home.
And there, at the end of the trail, are two little blue fish.
They have been waiting all these years.
Every day they laid out new shells.
They all live together by the coral.
